"AI and clean energy are no longer separate stories, but intertwined forces that are defining our collective future."

Together with distinguished colleagues - @Chen Ying, @Yuncheng Xu, @Peng Yijie, Saifur Rahman, @Jerry Lou, and Dennis She I had the privilege to moderate “The Future of the Energy–AI Nexus: How can AI accelerate a just energy transition by scaling finance and innovation?” 

We meet at a moment of transformation. Clean energy is scaling at unprecedented speed; solar PV has grown more than 60x in a decade, and EVs now account for 1 in 5 new cars sold. In the same period, AI has reshaped entire industries. Their convergence creates not just opportunities, but new possibilities and a shared responsibility to direct them wisely. From our session, three priorities came through strongly:

🌐 AI as an enabler of access and affordability:
AI is already improving forecasts and grid management, potentially unlocking 175 GW of additional transmission capacity worldwide. The next step is ensuring these gains translate into reliable, affordable power for schools, hospitals, and communities, not just advanced markets 

🌐 Finance, trust, and inclusion as the bridge to scale:
Clean energy investment reached USD 2.2 trillion in 2025, but less than 15% flows to emerging economies beyond China. AI can reduce transaction costs and clarify risks, unlocking much-needed private capital. But safeguards and transparent data are vital to ensure inclusion 

🌐 Policy and innovation aligning for impact: 
AI is already accelerating breakthroughs; from new battery chemistries to efficiency gains that could cut energy use in light manufacturing by 8% by 2035. But technology alone is not enough. Policy must steer innovation toward human development - powering clinics, creating jobs and building resilience across the Global South. 

At UNDP we believe the energy transition will only succeed if it is inclusive - creating jobs, powering clinics and schools, and building resilience across the Global South. The question is no longer if AI will shape energy, but how we choose to direct it.
